seed: Express the mechanics as pairwise interactions between types with named guards, such as blocking, pushing, collecting or toggling, and derive single-type rules from them.

synth.notes:
Ring (player) moves y+-6 on A1/A2, carrying blocks on the beam and pushing any block it hits (push chain); the whole move is cancelled if a block would leave the colour-4 field.
A4/A3 change beam width by 6: a hooked next/collected block at tip-4 drags the on-beam blocks, otherwise extending pushes the swept blocks; if the group is blocked, the beam moves alone.
Collect/revert tags drive the legend centres. Clicks (A6) do nothing.
Frame render: erase old object cells to the background (field 4, rail period-6 2/3, else 5), then draw by layer.
Hidden state: HUD bar 3s=(n-1)//3 with n = non-click actions, kept only while frames are continuous (stateless fallback 3*bars+1). Open hypothesis: bar phase cannot be read from a single frame.
